text: I find myself amidst clean geometry and glass, observing the quiet structure of an office or conference space. The sterile calm is punctuated by the practical presence of a fire extinguisher—an emblem of preparedness in an otherwise neutral environment. Stepping forward, the world bursts into vibrant color and idea: I am now greeted by murals of innovation, where symbols and words invoke the spirit of research and development. I feel a sense of curiosity and awakening, invited to engage with the intellectual vitality these displays offer. The contrast makes me reflect on how spaces shape thought—one encourages quiet reflection, the other inspires bold invention. I feel intrigued and ready to explore.
